messages:
marta: Quick internal GA notice: Realtime Function Streaming (fnstream-v1) + lighthouse-13b are live on Hosted API as of now. :confetti_ball:

marta: This introduces first-class streamed function exports: model can emit function calls as discrete stream events, and the runtime guarantees FIFO ordering per session. Main user wins: lower latency for tool-heavy agents and deterministic tool invocation ordering.

owen: Short compatibility note: existing streaming clients keep working. fnstream-v1 is opt-in via `?fnstream=true` query or `runtime.enable_fnstream=true` in the JSON body.

psf-bot: Docs & migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/fnstream-v1-migration  includes Node/Python/Go examples and a checklist for validating tool ordering.

marta: Wire changes: stream chunks may include a JSON fragment with `fn_event` field and you can see `x-rw-fn-seq` header on HTTP fallbacks. Also added metric `fnstream_invocations`.

infra-bot: Rollout plan: immediate canary in us-east-1 (30m), then staged to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 over 8h. Monitor `fnstream.latency.p95`, `fnstream.errors`, and `fnstream.order_violations`. Page eng-oncall if `fnstream.order_violations` > 0.1% for 10m.

billing-bot: Billing change: new meter `fnstream_token` for streamed function tokens. We will not retroactively charge during the 30-day migration window; customers will see line items after that. Sales will receive a CSV of affected customers.

owen: Quick smoke test (websocket):
```
# connect with fnstream enabled
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/realtime?fnstream=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
# send user input
{
  "type":"input","input":"Find latest price for widget X","session_id":"s1"
}
# expected function event from model
{
  "fn_event":{"name":"price_lookup","args":{"sku":"widget-x"}},"seq":42
}
```

marta: SDK teams: please add helpers to reassemble `fn_event` fragments and surface `x-rw-fn-seq` in response metadata.

docs-bot: I'll publish a short migration guide and examples in ~30m.

marta: Action items: docs (docs-bot) publish guide, SDKs (owen) add helpers, eng monitor canary (infra-bot), finance to prepare billing comms (billing-bot).

infra-bot: Canary update at 2177778950: us-east-1 canary green, negligible error delta. Proceeding with staged rollout.

marta: Thanks team  external announcement scheduled after global rollout completes. Ping if you need early-access for customers.
